book.name: MULUM PASA
book.title: MULUM PASA Kuate tuku mulum pasa Mosesŋge kuyarna

content: Kuate nu taŋgo tuku mane tugu mbilniŋge likina
O buk tugu mbolŋge taŋgo pino kilke ŋakmba mbolŋge pasa ndindo agaŋ ndende ŋakmba nyu ndindo saka minnaig.
Nane ki prote kumamŋge kine promba minnaig. Taŋamba minnaig ma ma mara ande nane kinaig ka Babilonia tuku ma gutoŋ ande mbol pronaig sulumba nane taŋge tumbraŋ ulnaig.

Taŋamba nane naŋgine naŋgine sakinaig: Sine kilke kilmba pasoka ndame wakeikube le kareŋguwaig ŋginaig. Nane taŋamba wakeikinaig sulumba wande palmbim tuku gulgol ta tumba ndame ta pisneniŋginaig le ndame ta deŋginaig.

Kile nane ndek sakinaig: Sine tumbraŋ suŋgo ande ulmba wande patikube sulumba wande suŋgo kuen ŋayo ande pilbe. Funu ka samba kirewa. Taŋamba sine nyu ŋak minbe sulumba sili-silimba ma tugu ŋakmba kine ndakube ŋginaig.
Nane wande ta pilnaig le Suŋgo nu nane tumbraŋ ulmba wande kuen ŋayo pilnaig ta kaŋgeram ndekina sulumba
sakina: Taŋgo pino nane ndare ndindo pasa kuale ndindo. Nane maŋau te tugu pilmba kade ta ŋgumneŋga naŋgine nzali dubimba maŋau afu kam tuku sakuwaig sulumba ta kamŋgaig.
Ta tuku sine ndek kab sulumba taŋgo tuku mane tugu mbilniŋbe le nane naŋgine naŋgine pasa katese ndawaig ŋgina.
Taŋakina sulumba Suŋgo nu taŋgo pino ŋakmba tugena le nane wande piro suŋgo ta kusremba sili-silimba kilke tugu ŋakmba mbol kine likinaig.
Tumbraŋ suŋgo ta nyunu Babilon ŋginaig. Ma ta mbolŋge Suŋgo nu nane tuku mane tugu mbilniŋge likina le nane sili-silimba kilke tugu ŋakmba mbol kine likinaig.
Sem tuku ndare
Sem tuku ndare tuturmba teŋenmba kina. Kule suŋgo ta ibeŋ kina le yar armba kinaig le Sem nu yar 100 ŋak minmba kiŋo ande nyunu Arpaksad te-pilna.
Te-pilna sulumba nu maŋ lato yar 500 kusremba kiŋo kulim afu turmba kile-patikina.
Arpaksad nu yar 35 ŋak minna sulumba kiŋo ande nyunu Sela te-pilna.
Te-pilna sulumba nu maŋ lato yar 403 minmba kiŋo kulim afu turmba kile-patikina.
Sela nu yar 30 ŋak minna sulumba kiŋo ande nyunu Eber te-pilna.
Te-pilna sulumba nu maŋ lato yar 403 minmba kiŋo kulim afu turmba kile-patikina.
Eber nu yar 34 ŋak minna sulumba kiŋo ande nyunu Pelek te-pilna.
Te-pilna sulumba nu maŋ lato yar 430 minmba kiŋo kulim afu turmba kile-patikina.
Pelek nu yar 30 ŋak minna sulumba kiŋo ande nyunu Reu te-pilna.
Te-pilna sulumba nu maŋ lato yar 209 minmba kiŋo kulim afu turmba kile-patikina.
Reu nu yar 32 ŋak minna sulumba kiŋo ande nyunu Seruk te-pilna.
Te-pilna sulumba nu maŋ lato yar 207 minmba kiŋo kulim afu turmba kile-patikina.
Seruk nu yar 30 ŋak minna sulumba kiŋo ande nyunu Nahor te-pilna.
Te-pilna sulumba nu maŋ lato yar 200 minmba kiŋo kulim afu turmba kile-patikina.
Nahor nu yar 29 ŋak minna sulumba kiŋo ande nyunu Tera te-pilna.
Te-pilna sulumba nu maŋ lato yar 119 minmba kiŋo kulim afu turmba kile-patikina.
Tera nu yar 70 kusrena sulumba kiŋo afu kile-patikina ta ande nyunu Abram ande Nahor ande Haran.
Tera tuku ndare

Tera tuku ndare tuturmba teŋenmba kina. Nu kiŋo keŋmba kile-patikina ta ande Abram ande Nahor ande Haran. Haran nu Lot te-pilna sulumba nu kulim armba turmba kile-patikina ta ande nyunu Milka ande Iska. Mam naŋgine kume ndakina le Haran nu amboŋga nuŋe tumbraŋ tuguk Urŋge minmba kumna. Ma tugu ta nyunu Babilonia. Abram nu Sarai tina le Nahor nu mambo nuŋe Haran tuku kulim Milka tina.
Sarai nu niŋka kiŋo kugatok minna.

Kile Tera nu kiŋo nuŋe Abram rugan nuŋe Sarai wa nuŋe Lot nane keŋ ta kilmba Babilonia ma tugu Ur tumbraŋ kusremba Kanan kilke mbol kambim saka kinaig kumba ka Haran tumbraŋ promba taŋge minnaig ma ma Tera nu kumna.
Nu yar ŋakmba 205 kusrena sulumba Haran tumbraŋ taŋge nu kumna.
